messages.subject: Interleave summarise_each() Output
parts:
A small example:

library(dplyr)

df <- data.frame(name=rep(LETTERS[1:3], each=20), weight=runif(60,60, 100), height=runif(60, 100, 150))

df %>%
group_by(name) %>%
summarise_each(., funs(mean(., na.rm=TRUE), sd(., na.rm=TRUE)))

What I would like to see is the mean and sd output be interleaved so I get:
mean sd mean sd
instead of:
mean mean sd sd 

Other than moving the columns afterwards, can summarise_each() be made to do this for me? 

If not, what are efficient ways of reorganizing the columns as above? 

Thanks, 
Brandon
